verdict.rationale: A native mobile app is a fair question for a project-tracking SaaS like Shortcut, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions iOS/Android or any native mobile app. It covers only the REST API, the MCP server, web features and pricing tiers, none of which are mobile-app capabilities.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can manage my tasks from a full-featured native mobile app without missing desktop functionality
